name: MCP
description: Inspect, authenticate, and call configured MCP servers, including servers discovered from active skill-local mcp.json files.

tools.name: mcp
tools.title: MCP
tools.description: Inspect and call MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers. Supports listing configured servers, inspecting tools, calling tools, searching tools, and managing OAuth authentication.

server.description: MCP server name. Required for info, grep, call, auth, logout.

tool.description: Tool name within the server. Used with info and call actions.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to search tools. Used with grep action. Supports * wildcards.

arguments.description: JSON string of arguments to pass to the tool. Used with call action. Example: '{"query":"hello"}'

probe.description: When listing servers, whether to fetch and display their tools. Default false.

settingsComponent.label: MCP servers
settingsComponent.description: MCP wrapper config for explicit tool servers, active skill-local mcp.json detection, and runtime tool orchestration.
